curaprox.badge: Most visited oral-care brand in Switzerland
curaprox.text: The only oral-care brand site in Switzerland’s top 10,000. Colgate, elmex, Trisa and Oral-B are in the top 50,000; meridol and TePe in the top 100,000; Sensodyne, Waterpik and happybrush in the top 500,000.

fc-basel-1893.badge: Top 2 football club site in Switzerland
fc-basel-1893.text: One of only two Swiss football clubs with an official site in Switzerland’s top 1,000. The other is FC St. Gallen, which I also worked on.

fc-st-gallen-1879.badge: Top 2 football club site in Switzerland
fc-st-gallen-1879.text: One of only two Swiss football clubs with an official site in Switzerland’s top 1,000. The other is FC Basel 1893, which I also worked on.

confiserie-sprungli.text: The only Swiss chocolatier in Switzerland’s top 5,000. Lindt and Cailler are in the top 10,000; Camille Bloch, Honold, Maestrani and Max Chocolatier in the top 50,000.

skypergola.badge: Most visited pergola brand in Switzerland
skypergola.text: Ahead of every other pergola and awning brand checked: Warema, Griesser and Pergola-Line are in the top 50,000, Weinor and Solarlux in the top 100,000, Renson and Markilux in the top 500,000.

revendo.text: In the top 5,000 together with refurbed.ch, the only other refurbished-electronics shop that high. Recommerce is in the top 10,000; Back Market and Swappie in the top 100,000.

fc-zurich.text: In the top 5,000 with Young Boys, Servette, Grasshoppers, Sion, Thun, Lausanne-Sport and Winterthur. Only FC Basel and FC St. Gallen rank higher among Swiss football clubs.

ev-zug.text: In the top 10,000 with HC Lugano, EHC Kloten, HC Ajoie and the Rapperswil-Jona Lakers. SC Bern, ZSC Lions, HC Davos, Fribourg-Gottéron, Lausanne HC, SCL Tigers and Ambrì-Piotta are in the top 5,000.

nile.text: In the top 5,000 with fashion retailers PKZ, Chicorée and Bongénie, ahead of Tally Weijl and Companys (top 50,000). Department stores Globus and Manor are in the top 1,000.

ecofort.text: In the top 5,000 with Dyson, Jura and Kärcher, ahead of Stadler Form, Trisa, Rowenta (top 50,000), Meaco (top 100,000) and Boneco (top 500,000).

nikin.text: In the top 10,000 with sustainable fashion brands Armedangels and Hessnatur, ahead of Patagonia, Vaude and Odlo (top 50,000).

lush-switzerland.text: In the top 10,000 with Weleda and Nivea, ahead of The Body Shop, Kiehl’s, Aesop, Dr. Hauschka and Lavera (top 50,000). Rituals and Yves Rocher are in the top 5,000.

pyrostar-bugano-and-weco.text: No Swiss fireworks shop ranks higher: Pyrostar is in the top 50,000 with Feuerwerkshop.ch, Vulcanet and Feuerwerksverkauf.ch.
